selection_rule: each arm keeps its own minimum-validation-loss checkpoint; no checkpoint or metric is re-selected here
notes: seed level n = 3 is the primary evidence
nine scenes inside one seed are not independent experiments
plateau epoch-to-epoch std is a training-stability diagnostic, not seed variance
a run whose best epoch lies in its final patience window is budget_censored
per_band curves are scene means of ||error_b||/||truth_b||, a mean of per-scene ratios and not comparable to cube_relative_l2
per-band stability is not evaluated here; use band_seeds.py for that
validation loss is not compared across arms: each arm uses its own forward RMS as both the noise scale and the data-loss normaliser
